shots.name: e02-p-guess-wrong
shots.js: const p = __gt.course.lessons.find(l => l.id === '1-1').predict; document.querySelectorAll('.opt')[(p.answer + 2) % 4].click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 800)); return scrollY;

shots.name: e03-p-watch-arrive
shots.js: return {hash: location.hash, fold: (() => { const c = document.querySelector('.controls')?.getBoundingClientRect(), s = document.querySelector('.stage')?.getBoundingClientRect(); return c ? {stageTop: Math.round(s.top), stageH: Math.round(s.height), stageW: Math.round(s.width), controlsBottom: Math.round(c.bottom), vh: innerHeight, cut: Math.max(0, Math.round(c.bottom - innerHeight))} : null; })(), overlay: document.querySelector('.overlay .box').innerText};

shots.name: e04-p-watch-playing-6s
shots.js: document.querySelector('.bigplay').click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 6000)); return {time: document.querySelector('.time').textContent, paused: __gt.player.audio.paused, y: scrollY, fold: (() => { const c = document.querySelector('.controls')?.getBoundingClientRect(), s = document.querySelector('.stage')?.getBoundingClientRect(); return c ? {stageTop: Math.round(s.top), stageH: Math.round(s.height), stageW: Math.round(s.width), controlsBottom: Math.round(c.bottom), vh: innerHeight, cut: Math.max(0, Math.round(c.bottom - innerHeight))} : null; })()};

shots.name: e12-p-complete
shots.js: await __gt.player.show(8, false); document.querySelector('.overlay').hidden = true; document.querySelectorAll('.cue.off').forEach(e => e.classList.remove('off')); __gt.player.next(true); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 900)); return scrollY;
